principle: Independence is decided by ANCESTRY, not by document count. Two URLs are not two roots. Unknown ancestry is UNKNOWN, never Independent.

SOURCE.source_id: stable id for a cited artifact (file, url, transcript, filing, interview)
SOURCE.kind: PRIMARY_DOCUMENT | PRESS_RELEASE | ARTICLE | TRANSCRIPT | SUMMARY | FILING | INTERVIEW | DATASET | LLM_OUTPUT | UNKNOWN
derives_from: source_id ... — KNOWN provenance ancestors (edges of the ancestry graph); [] if none known

ANCESTRY_GRAPH.type: G_E = (V, E) directed: V=sources, E=derives_from edges (child -> ancestor)
ANCESTRY_GRAPH.note: Built from declared/known derivation only. Missing edge != absence of ancestry; it is UNKNOWN.

PROVENANCE_ROOT.root_id: id of an independent source root (a maximal set of sources joined by known ancestry)
members: source_id ... that share a known ancestry path
PROVENANCE_ROOT.rule: sources a,b are the SAME root iff a known ancestry path joins them (a derives_from* b, b derives_from* a, or common ancestor).

INDEPENDENCE_STATUS.INDEPENDENT: no known ancestry relation joins the two roots within the observed corpus
INDEPENDENCE_STATUS.SHARED_ANCESTRY: a known ancestry path joins them -> collapse to ONE root
INDEPENDENCE_STATUS.UNKNOWN: ancestry not established -> DO NOT count as independent; hold as UNKNOWN (fail-closed on independence)

IndependentRoot_predicate: IndependentRoot(a,b) <=> no known provenance-ancestor relation joins a and b within the observed corpus. If ancestry is unestablished => UNKNOWN, NOT Independent.

worked_examples.case: company press release + article quoting that release
two agents citing the same source
Wikipedia + blog quoting Wikipedia + LLM summary of that blog
worked_examples.why: chain of derives_from -> one root, NOT 3
no known ancestry link -> potentially INDEPENDENT (2)
must NOT be auto-counted as 2 independent roots

N_E_rule: N_E counts INDEPENDENT provenance roots only. SHARED_ANCESTRY collapses. UNKNOWN is reported separately (UNKNOWN_ANCESTRY bucket) and NOT added to N_E.

ROOT_TYPE.OPERATING: a meeting/CR/transcript by the entity itself — witnesses 'entity DISCUSSED/ASSERTED X on date Y' (a self-report)
ROOT_TYPE.STRATEGY: a plan/business-plan/positioning doc by the entity — witnesses 'entity INTENDS/PLANS X'
ROOT_TYPE.COMMERCIAL: the entity's own commercial material about its offering
ROOT_TYPE.EXTERNAL: a source NOT authored by the entity (third-party filing, independent interview, customer/partner record)

ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.law: A root's TYPE bounds the claim TYPE it can license. DifferentFiles != IndependentEvidence, and SelfAuthoredRoot |- 'entity said X'  but  |/- 'X is externally true'.
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.OPERATING |-: SELF_REPORT: 'entity asserted/discussed X on date Y' — NEVER external truth or market fact
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.STRATEGY |-: INTENT: 'entity plans X' — NEVER 'X is validated/operating'
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.COMMERCIAL |-: OFFER: claims about the entity's own offering — NEVER independent market demand
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.EXTERNAL |-: the ONLY root type that can license externally-corroborated / SOURCE-BACKED status
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.status_ceiling: self-authored roots (OPERATING/STRATEGY/COMMERCIAL) cap a claim at BUILDING/INTENDED/CLAIMED. SOURCE-BACKED / externally-corroborated REQUIRES >=1 EXTERNAL root. This ceiling is what a downstream website's status label must obey.
ROOT_TYPE_LICENSING.temporal: claims carry (date, version); the graph is temporal G=(V,E,tau,pi,s) so a proposition's evolution and contradictions across dates are visible, not flattened.
